d: Would you like to be part of the most international company in the world? A company operating in more than 220 countries worldwide and has been pioneering cross-border express shipping since 1969. Would you like to be part of a business that connects people across the globe and want to make a difference? Then waste no time and join our amazing team at DHL Group. DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the Group's air, ocean, and road freight specialist. We offer standardized transport as well as highly specialized end-to-end solutions to customers in a wide range of industries globally.

Who finds the right solutions at the right time? You do! Then we need to hear from you. Grab this unique opportunity to join the best Freight forward company.- DHL Global Forwarding has an opening for a Operations Supervisor (NE) in Ras al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. Coordinate airfreight operations plans and processes to deliver flow of goods and information across the customer’s global supply chain. Engage proactively with customers and manage shipments against the customer or delivery expectation in line with business strategy and objectives, corporate guidelines and policies.
Join us in connecting people and improving lives!
Coordinate airfreight operations plans and processes in line with business strategy and requirements, global guidelines and policies
Coach, guide and ensure team are trained for execution of day-to-day tasks and activities and meet work schedules and targets at a department/ small unit with multiple team's level
Identify and resolve recurring issues, and suggest modifications to airfreight operations work methods focusing on increasing effectiveness and efficiency
Provide input for processes and design systems to enhance service quality and alignment with company’s direction and long-term goals
Identify performance issues of suppliers, and propose solutions to improve performance
May use Industry sector or logistics specialist expertise in their day-to-day work
Participate to develop, maintain and achieve airfreight operations productivity and profitability targets
Ensure that correct costs and revenues are captured by the team against customer’s profile and react to related excess profit/loss
Support team to deliver excellent quality and to resolve related quality issues
Manage team to ensure shipments are transported in line with the customer service commitment,
Responsible for team shipment data quality
Ensure necessary regulatory compliance procedures are followed relating to commodity and locations
Support new business during hypercare phases
Answer queries, prepare information for customer visits and participate in customer visits relating to operational topics
Supervise tasks and activities while meeting resource management and productivity guidelines for the day-to-day operations
Escalation point for existing clients and ensure a desired level of customer retention
Identify opportunities to expand business with clients
Continuously improve in-house customer interaction focused on proactive shipment information incident/complaint management, ad hoc pricing, and claims
Use available tools to proactively monitor and improve performance
Conduct regular dialogues with team to review quality and performance levels vs targets
Ensure customer invoice timeliness and accuracy
Understand customer and key stakeholders interests and concerns and advise direct reports, customers and key stakeholders
Regular contact with other specialist departments
Cooperate with 3rd parties e.g. external service providers
